seoTitle: Embr — Native Twitch Client for iPhone and iPad
metaDescription: A fast, native Twitch client for iPhone and iPad with every 7TV, BTTV and FFZ emote, plus Embr Studio for streamers. Open source.
heroSubhead: A fast, native Twitch client for iPhone and iPad. Streams play in Apple’s own player and keep going in the background, and chat is drawn natively with every emote from Twitch, 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ, across every room you keep open.
highlights: Native AVPlayer with picture-in-picture and background audio
Chat with every 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emote
Embr Studio: your stream's control room on iPhone and iPad
Open source, no tracking, your token stays in the Keychain

features.title: A real native player
features.body: Live streams, VODs, and clips play in AVPlayer, not a web wrapper. Picture-in-picture, background audio, quality selection, fullscreen, playback speed, latency display, and double-tap to seek — all the controls a native app should have.

features.title: Embr Studio, for streamers
features.body: Keep your own channel on a screen while you're live: chat you can read from across the room, the next ad break counting down with Snooze and Run Ad, and every follow, sub, raid, hype train, poll and prediction as it happens. Moderate from the couch with the Siri Remote, get a recap after every stream, and try it all on a sample stream before you sign in. On iPhone and iPad.

features.title: Chat that keeps up
features.body: Real-time chat over Twitch EventSub with replies, badges, cheermotes, and emote autocomplete. Animated emotes from Twitch, 7TV, BetterTTV, and FrankerFaceZ are merged into a single stream so messages render exactly as your community uses them. Past broadcasts replay their chat in sync with the video, so a VOD feels like the live show.

features.title: Find something to watch
features.body: Browse live channels and top categories, search across the catalog, and open any stream in a tap. A dedicated Following tab keeps your channels close once you sign in. Star channels to keep them one tap away, show only your favorites in Top, and choose whether Embr opens on Following, Favorites or Top.

features.title: Moderation built in
features.body: Report or block in a long-press, and pull up full moderator tools when you run a channel. Chat search and per-message actions keep busy rooms manageable.

features.title: Liquid glass, native feel
features.body: Programmatic UIKit with a premium liquid-glass design, symbol effects on live states, and the snappy, gesture-driven feel of an app built for the platform — not a port.

features.title: Yours to inspect
features.body: Embr is open source. Browse a stream as a guest with no account, or sign in with Twitch via OAuth when you want Following and chat. Your token lives in the Keychain only, and there is no tracking.

howItWorks.body: Open Embr and explore live channels, top categories, and search straight away — no account needed to watch.
Tap any stream for native AVPlayer playback with picture-in-picture, background audio, and real-time chat side by side.
Connect your Twitch account with OAuth to follow channels, chat with your emotes, and use moderator tools.

faq.a: No. Embr is an independent, third-party Twitch client. It is not made, endorsed, or affiliated with Twitch or Amazon. Twitch is a trademark of its owner.

faq.q: Do I need a Twitch account to use Embr?
faq.a: No. You can browse live channels, categories, search, and watch streams, VODs, and clips entirely as a guest. Sign in with Twitch only when you want a Following tab, to chat, or to use moderator tools.

faq.q: What can the video player do?
faq.a: Embr uses a native AVPlayer for live streams, VODs, and clips, with picture-in-picture, background audio, quality selection, fullscreen, playback speed, latency display, and double-tap to seek.

Chat runs over Twitch EventSub in real time and merges animated emotes from Twitch, 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ into one stream, with an emote keyboard that has a section for each, alongside badges, cheermotes, replies and emote autocomplete.

A screen for your own Twitch channel while you're live, on iPhone and iPad: your chat, the next ad break, and every follow, sub, raid and hype train. It reads your channel through Twitch's official API and plays no video. Chat, alerts and moderating your own channel are free; Studio Pro adds ad controls, alert sounds, stream recaps, moderator mode and quick messages for $3.99 a month, $29.99 a year or $79.99 once, and every streamer gets a free week of it from their first live stream in Studio.

faq.q: Can I moderate my channel from Embr?
faq.a: Yes. Turn on Moderator Tools in Settings and, in the channels you moderate, allow or deny AutoMod's held messages, answer unban requests and read the moderation log. A user card adds delete, time out and ban. Anyone can report or block from a message.
Yes. Embr does not track you. Sign-in uses Twitch's official OAuth, and your access token is stored only in the iOS Keychain on your device.
Yes — Embr is built in the open, and the full source is on GitHub at github.com/guitaripod/embr.

faq.q: Which devices does Embr run on?
faq.a: Embr runs on iPhone and iPad, and adapts to iPhone Duo's inner and outer displays.

faq.q: Can I keep several chats open?
faq.a: Yes. The Chats tab keeps chats open without their video, with unread and mention counts on each, and Mentions gathers what mentions you from all of them. On iPad, up to three chats sit side by side.

No. Watching, chat and browsing are free. Streamers can add Studio Pro to Embr Studio by the month, the year or once. Tips and a one-time Founding Supporter purchase are optional; Founding Supporter unlocks only looks, and you can try each one on first.
